species.sourceSummary: Allen CCFv3 OBJ structure meshes joined to structure_graph_1.json.
catalogNotes: Mouse rows are mesh-backed by staged Allen OBJ files.

licenseCaveat: Verify Allen Institute terms of use and citation requirements before redistributing derived GLB assets.

meshNamingConvention.description: Current Blender packer imports each Allen OBJ as an object named by its numeric file stem, matching meshName exactly, for example 1.

groupNormalization.description: Blank source CSV groups are normalized to frontend group Ungrouped. Source group text is preserved in sourceGroup.

duplicateLabelPolicy: Duplicate biological labels from source atlases are preserved. Use structureId or meshName, not label alone, as region identity.
